messages:
Maria (People Ops): Heads-up: we’re entering the last week to complete the annual privacy & compliance declaration. If you haven’t filled the form yet, please do so by EOD next Friday. Link: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/privacy/annual-declaration :calendar:

Maria (People Ops): What to include: a quick yes/no for training completion, whether you handle customer data, and an optional upload field for certs or artifact links. If you have SOC2 evidence to attach, paste a Confluence/Drive link.

Liam (Security): Quick clarification — if you work on Dedicated or Private infra, please mark the "handles customer data" box and attach any managed-hosting contracts or encryption attestations. Those count as evidence.

Jules (Eng): @Maria is there a small checklist for what qualifies as "training completed"? I did the micro-course but didn’t see a cert.

Maria (People Ops): Good Q. Training completed = either a certificate or a registration entry in LMS. If you can’t get a cert, paste a screenshot of the LMS completion page or the course URL + timestamp.

Aisha (SRE): Uploaded my certs already — posted to Confluence under /evidence/sre/2026-q1. @Liam can you confirm that’s sufficient?

Liam (Security): Thanks Aisha — I’ll spot-check this afternoon. For checklist: encryption keys, access-review doc, and change-control log are the high-value artifacts for infra teams.

Jules (Eng): One more — I’ll be oncall next Tue-Wed. If I can’t finish by deadline, what’s the extension process?

Maria (People Ops): If you need an exception, fill the extension request: https://forms.redwoodinference.com/compliance-exception and cc people-ops@redwood.com. Include expected completion date and blocker. Exceptions are granted case-by-case; please request before the deadline.

Jules (Eng): Got it, filing now.

reminder-bot: Automated reminder scheduled — everyone who hasn’t submitted will receive a DM 48h before deadline.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks all. If anyone needs hands-on help (screenshots, where to upload), drop here or DM me and we’ll pair up. :+1:
